name: 48025 · Bingham Farms, MI
findings: ZIP 48025 (Bingham Farms) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48025 (Bingham Farms) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48025 (Bingham Farms) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.
